verdict.rationale: A hands-on community report confirms Jev can be reached through OpenRouter, and the first-party SDK changelog mentions examples for using it with AI gateways. That shows at least one router-class channel beyond TypeSafe's own endpoint. There is no evidence of availability on Bedrock, Vertex, or Azure, and no dedicated docs page for gateway or OpenRouter access. Missing for 10: Bedrock/Vertex/Azure availability, first-party documentation of OpenRouter or gateway routing beyond a changelog line.

support.subject: As a founder, I can consume the same models through major clouds or gateways — Bedrock, Vertex, Azure, or OpenRouter-class routers — not only the vendor's own endpoint

citations.quote: I gave JEV a shot via OpenRouter and it has a reply in less than 400ms
